text: Miss USA 1976 was the 25th edition of the Miss USA pageant, broadcast live by CBS from Niagara Falls, New York, on May 15, 1976. Barbara Peterson from Minnesota won the title, succeeding Summer Bartholomew of California, who had held the previous year's title. Peterson was the first and, as of now, the only woman from Minnesota to win the Miss USA crown. She went on to compete in Miss Universe 1976, becoming the first Miss USA titleholder to not advance to the semi-final round of that competition.
